title: swarmery project overlay config
description: Per-project flavor config read by core agents/skills/hooks at runtime. Replaces the old token-rewrite (adapt) class: framework files reference these values instead of baking in project names.

name.description: kebab-case slug; also the workspace + AGENT_PROJECT key

codePath.description: absolute path to the project's code repo(s) root

monorepo.description: monorepo root dir name, if any

device.description: edge/IoT device repo name, if any

domainTerms.description: domain nouns used in prompts (product, device, threatModelExample, …)

enabledPacks.description: domain packs this project enables (mirrors .claude/settings.json enabledPlugins)

jira.description: Issue-tracker contract consumed by jira-pack. Required for /jira-fix. This fragment is mirrored in plugins/jira-pack/requirements.json, which the dashboard renders the config form from; scripts/check-plugin-requirements.sh fails CI when the two drift, so change both in one commit.

qaStatus.description: Exact target status name the agent moves a finished ticket to

repro.description: Commands the agent runs to reproduce. setup is optional; test is mandatory.

budget.description: Autonomy limits before the run escalates to planning.

design.description: Design-handoff contract consumed by design-pack. Required for /design-implement. This fragment is mirrored in plugins/design-pack/requirements.json, which the dashboard renders the config form from; scripts/check-plugin-requirements.sh fails CI when the two drift, so change both in one commit.

tokensFile.description: Repo-relative CSS file that holds the design tokens an implementation must extend rather than duplicate, e.g. src/app/globals.css

componentsRoot.description: Repo-relative directory the reuse-vs-create survey walks before anything new is built, e.g. src/components

routesRoot.description: Repo-relative directory holding routable pages, e.g. src/app

fontLoader.description: How this project loads typefaces. A design font missing from the project stops the run with instructions written for this loader; it is never silently substituted.

devCommand.description: Command that serves the app so an implemented route can be screenshotted, e.g. npm run dev

devUrl.description: Base URL devCommand serves on, e.g. http://localhost:3000. Never a shared or production origin.

verify.description: Check commands run after implementation. Both are mandatory.

lint.description: Lint command, e.g. npm run lint

diff.description: Pixel-diff acceptance for the verification phase.

threshold.description: Maximum percentage of differing pixels that still counts as a match

pixelTolerance.description: Per-pixel colour tolerance passed to the diff, 0 = exact

budget.description: Autonomy limits before the implementation agent stops and returns the decision to the operator.

maxIterations.description: Diff-then-fix rounds the agent may run unattended

maxFiles.description: Files the agent may touch before it must stop

graft.description: Context-graph contract consumed by graft-pack. Optional — every field has a default, so an enabled pack works with no `graft` block at all. This fragment is mirrored in plugins/graft-pack/requirements.json, which the dashboard renders the config form from; scripts/check-plugin-requirements.sh fails CI when the two drift, so change both in one commit.

graphDir.description: Repo-relative directory holding the graft index, i.e. the value passed to `graft --dir`. The wiring graph the blast-radius hook reads is <graphDir>/.graph/wiring.json.

promptContext.description: Inject file:line locators from the graph into a prompt when the graph covers it. Turn off for a project whose graph is too sparse to be worth the tokens; the SWARMERY_GRAFT_PROMPT=0 env var is the per-session equivalent.

blastRadius.description: After each Edit/Write, name the files that depend on the edited file. Turn off for a project where edits are mostly leaf files; the SWARMERY_GRAFT_BLAST=0 env var is the per-session equivalent.

maxDependents.description: Most dependents the blast-radius note lists before it truncates to a `+N more` line. A hook is a nudge, not a report — a long list is scrolled past.
